description: Find host resource and service problems before choosing a fix. Read system, network, storage and certificate facts without changing the host. Start with load or disks; available sections depend on the Linux account running this agent.
author: Serg Parf

all.help: Review every section available to the agent's Linux account. Disk health and hardware sensor sections require root.

system.help: Identify the host and its running kernel.

disks.help: Inspect disks and check free filesystem space.

load.help: Check system load and process counts.

tls.help: Check the public TLS certificate's fingerprint, names and expiry, including days left. Compare its fingerprint with the token helper's pin.

uptime.help: Check how long the host has run and its load averages.

inodes.help: Check filesystem inode usage, which can prevent new files even when bytes remain free.

pressure.help: Check how much CPU, memory and input/output contention delays work.

units.help: Find failed services and other systemd units.

time.help: Check the clock and whether it is synchronized.

users.help: See which users are logged in.

virt.help: Identify the virtualization type. A bare-metal host reports none.

health.help: Inspect disk health. This section requires the agent to run as root.

sensors.help: Read hardware temperatures and other sensor values. This section requires the agent to run as root.

help.help: Find available calls. Use help-config for configuration and help-secret for environment key names.
